title: Prove a third-moment QQ16 transcript bound
body:
## Summary

```diff
 QQ16 fixed F0/B_1_2 erased-family contract
-necessary rational record width per owner >= 13
+necessary rational record width per owner >= 14
```

Adds `research/qq16-third-moment-capacity/` with a written proof, exact source-bound verifier, receipt, failure controls and registered replay. The new third moment gives

```text
rank([B0;B1;B2]) >= 280|G|/13
selected A/T defect >= ceil(176|G|/13)
width-13 residual >= ceil(7|G|/13)
```

This is an information bound for read-only rational-linear records, not paid recursive rank, an exact transcript minimum or supplier admission. Widths fourteen and fifteen remain open. The selected frontier and frozen sources are unchanged.

Base canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Contribution `e18ca76987f5945c6a4b5b6bebbe73cdab3c4561`. Task `joint-query-controller`, refined to the released sharper-rank handoff after live overlap showed the chooser's generic incumbent cards were covered. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2074#discussioncomment-18935134). Exact heads, scope, commands and freshness are in `TASK.json`; input blob/hash pins are in `SOURCES.json`.

## Evidence

- Before: Ross Richardson's #2104 supplies the two-moment rank bound `144|G|/7`; commdata2338's #2153 gives defect `88|G|/7` and excludes widths at most twelve.
- After: 18,432 ordered route products and a separate chart-swap reconstruction establish the new triple coefficient 6144. Exact moments `(24,28,109/3)` and a rational cubic spectral polynomial exclude width thirteen. No predecessor executable is imported.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-third-moment-capacity
python3.12 -I -O -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-third-moment-capacity
python3.12 -I -O -B research/qq16-third-moment-capacity/test_verify.py
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
make selected-record-check
```

Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.15, standard library. Both registered replays, seven focused tests, 65 workflow tests, `-Wall` compilation and selected-record integrity pass. Three semantic controls and CLI source/receipt corruption reject. The direct verifier also passes normally and optimized under a 512 MiB address-space cap; the Git provenance launcher ran uncapped because it maps the checkout's larger packfile. No hosted CI result is claimed.

Credit Ali Romman and #1969 for the conserved maps, route packet and erased witness; Ross Richardson #2104 for the rank method; commdata2338 #2153 for the joint A/T defect argument and #2174 for adjacent sixteen-coordinate recovery. Cinna Davis #2079/#2122 and Adam Gall #2086/#2093 are preceding query/logger investigations. Retained notices and supplier attribution are unchanged; new work is Apache-2.0.

The global erased-family trajectory remains inherited. Native local-word replay, the full selected cold replay, physical costs, recursive precision, independent human review and proof-assistant verification were not performed. This does not close a final-only controller or establish a new multiplication exponent.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Only one new opt-in research package; removal reverses the change.

Blast radius: package. No shared verifier, selected record or frozen input changes. The replay hook declares its exact QQ16 inputs.
